Completed task 'Add animation to form submission button' ahead of schedule. Please review and let me know if any tweaks are needed.

I also wanted to share some exciting news about our upcoming team-building event. We've been planning a fun and engaging day for everyone, and I'm confident it will be a great opportunity for everyone to unwind and bondd with their colleagues. I'll be sending out more details soon, so keep an eye out for that!

Cheers,
Luis
